The team currently competes in [[Serie A]], the first tier of [[Italian football league system|Italian football]]. It was founded on 30 November 1896 as a sports club, and on 5 July 1911 as a football club. Traditionally, the team's home kit consists of a black and white striped shirt, black shorts, and white socks. The club broadcasts on channel 110 ([[Udinese Channel]]) on [[digital terrestrial television]] in the north-east of Italy. It has many fans in [[Friuli]] and the surrounding areas."}}
